name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the oldest merged PR first. It validates routing and catches edge cases before newer PRs, reducing risk of misrouted feedback. The trade-off is slower feedback on recent PRs, but we prioritize stability over speed.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode on the oldest merged PR risks validating a stale routing path that may no longer reflect current logic—edge cases caught there could be irrelevant now. Instead, run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the *newest open PR* to test the *current* routing logic; if it fails there, the fix applies forward. Settle it by checking if the newest PR’s routing path is representative of the latest codebase state.
